reports.title: INNIO Reports Record Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results with Revenue Up 57%, Net Income Up 176% and Adjusted EBITDA Up 70%; Raises 2026 Full-Year Guidance

lines: •Raised Fiscal Year 2026 outlook: Total Revenue guidance raised by $100 million to $3.9 - $4.0 billion and Adjusted EBITDA2 guidance raised by $60 million to $780 - $800 million

Based on its year-to-date performance, INNIO raised its fiscal 2026 outlook for Total Revenue to $3.9 to $4.0 billion, up from $3.8 to $3.9 billion and for Adjusted EBITDA to $780 - $800 million, up from $720 to $740 million.
